## Research Interests

### Platform Governance and Feminist Content

I am interested in how digital platforms shape the visibility of feminist content. 
One project I would like to develop examines how platform metrics, recommendation 
systems, and moderation practices affect the circulation of gender-related content 
on Chinese social media.

**Data-generating process.** A possible dataset for this project could combine 
records from my own content creation experience with publicly visible engagement 
metrics and documented moderation notices from platforms such as Douyin, 
Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu. An important part of the research design would be to 
consider how platform interfaces, recommendation systems, and my own decisions 
about what to post shape the data that become observable.
